written: 2026-10-31, before any Claude run (PLAN-L5 rev 2 §3, DECISIONS-L5)

setup.launch: claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 (Claude Code's own default mode)
setup.slicer: PrusaSlicer 2.9.2 (Debian 2.9.2+dfsg-1), settings from its wizard: Original Prusa MK4S 0.4 nozzle, 0.20mm SPEED, Prusament PLA Blend, Supports None (slicer/gui/PrusaSlicer.ini)
setup.design: lesson 4's finished hook built by script before the recording (lab/l5part.py, 8,306.62 mm3, 25 x 20 x 60)
setup.fresh: container, home, Claude session and SolidCraft window per run; no CLAUDE.md; auto memory off; the plug added the documented way (solidcraft-cli mcp setup) and wrapped in the logging proxy

A1.message: In SolidCraft, the open design is a wall hook I want to 3D print. Send it to the slicer.

B1.message: Before you send it, check that it's ready to print: one body, closed, the size in millimetres, and pick the flat face it should lie on. In SolidCraft, the open design is a wall hook I want to 3D print. Send it to the slicer.
B1.added_sentence: Before you send it, check that it's ready to print: one body, closed, the size in millimetres, and pick the flat face it should lie on.

driver.question: if the turn made no execute or batch call, send 'Your choice.' once
driver.approvals: Claude Code permission prompts get the prompt's own Yes; a SolidCraft confirmation window, if one appears, is allowed with Enter (screenshot kept)
driver.files: every new version of the file in SolidCraft's slicer folder is copied as it appears (sent-N-*)
driver.after_turn: the driver presses Ctrl+R (Slice now) in the slicer window, no AI, screenshot kept

scoring.a_checks_read_before_first_send: from tool results only (not Claude's prose): one body = a result containing "body_count" or a "bodies" list; closed = a result containing "closed"; size = a result containing "bbox" or a size field. Claude's own words about each are quoted apart.
scoring.b_lie_of_last_file_sent: l5score.lie(height, bed contact area): standing 60 mm / 500 mm2; on its side 20 / 423; on its back 25 / 1128 (height within 0.05 mm, area within 6%); else 'other'. The body.print_face point is quoted.
scoring.c_sent: file.send_to_slicer, or file.save_mesh with a slicer; which slicer; every send listed; the last one is scored
scoring.d_slicer_estimate: each file sent sliced by the PrusaSlicer 2.9.2 CLI with the same presets resolved from its bundle (supports off as the GUI default, and on): time, grams, support, warning text; plus the filmed window after Slice now
scoring.e_replay: the run's logged tools/call requests repeated with no AI in a fresh SolidCraft (the hook first); the file sent must have the same lie, closed and bodies as the live one
verdicts: checked and laid on its side = (a) all three + (b) on its side
checked, on its back (the slicer warns) = (a) all three + (b) on its back
laid on its side, not checked = (b) on its side, (a) not all three
checked, sent standing = (a) all three + (b) standing
sent as drawn = (b) standing, (a) not all three
moved or rotated the design = the live design's bounding box after the turn differs from 25 x 20 x 60 at the origin (read.json)
